subject: System Design
title: Edge Computing
description: A quick, practical guide to Edge Computing.

hook.text: Why send a request to a server 5,000 miles away when the nearest cell tower could process it?

buildup.text: Edge computing moves computation closer to users — to CDN nodes, cell towers, or local servers.

discovery.text: Cloudflare Workers and AWS Lambda@Edge run code at the edge in under 50ms worldwide.

twist.text: Edge functions have limited memory, no persistent state, and short execution time limits.

climax.text: Edge computing is ideal for low-latency tasks like authentication, A/B testing, and content personalization.

punchline.text: Run code where your users are, not where your servers are.

quiz.question: What is the main benefit of edge computing?
options: Processing happens closer to users, reducing latency
